description: This file defines an options parser for the Bloodhound suggestion engine used in typeahead.js, including functions to parse prefetch and remote configurations, and utility functions for request handling.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse and merge options with defaults, ensuring required options are set, and processing local, prefetch, and remote options.

methods.name: parsePrefetch
methods.description: Parses the prefetch configuration object, setting defaults, supporting string or object input, and ensuring URL is set.

methods.name: parseRemote
methods.description: Parses the remote configuration object, setting defaults, supporting string or object input, and ensuring URL is set.

methods.name: toRemotePrepare
methods.description: Determines the prepare function for remote requests based on replace, wildcard, or default.

methods.name: toLimiter
methods.description: Creates a rate limiter function (debounce or throttle) based on configuration.

methods.name: callbackToDeferred
methods.description: Wraps a callback-based function to return a jQuery Deferred object.
